title: Theorem on formal functions over a Noetherian affine base
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], $\mathcal I=I\mathcal O_X\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ the image of $f^*\widetilde I\to f^*\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\to\mathcal O_X$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal] (the ideal sheaf generated by the images of the elements of $I$), and $\mathcal F$ a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], with $\mathcal I^n\mathcal F$ as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] (0). Fix $p\ge0$ and put $H=H^p(X,\mathcal F)$ [pqf-def-cohomology], an $A$-module, and $H^\wedge=\varprojlim_nH/I^nH$ its $I$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. The quotient maps $\mathcal F\to\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F$ induce $A$-linear maps $H\to H^p(X,\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F)$, which vanish on $I^nH$ (as $I^n$ acts on $\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F$ through $\mathcal I^n$, which kills it) and so induce maps $\theta_n:H/I^nH\to H^p(X,\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F)$ compatible with the transition maps on both sides. Then $\varprojlim_n\theta_n:H^\wedge\to\varprojlim_nH^p(X,\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F)$ is an isomorphism of $A$-modules. In particular ($p=0$) the maps $\Gamma(X,\mathcal F)/I^n\Gamma(X,\mathcal F)\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F)$ induce an isomorphism $\Gamma(X,\mathcal F)^\wedge\cong\varprojlim_n\Gamma(X,\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F)$.
